customManagers.description: Update marketplace plugins that use GitHub tags.
Update commit pins to the latest HEAD of the selected branch when tags are unavailable.
matchStrings: plugins[source.ref and source.sha and $contains(source.url, 'https://github.com/')].{ 'depName': name, 'packageName': $replace($substringAfter(source.url, 'https://github.com/'), /\.git$/, ''), 'currentValue': source.ref, 'currentDigest': source.sha }
